Nina Park: Hey team! quick question — where should i drop different types of questions during my first week? Also how do people keep slack sane (quiet hours, muting bots) without missing important alerts?

Luis Ramirez: Welcome Nina! Short guide: 
- Immediate access/setup issues -> #help (include name/team/resource/urgency)
- Infra/deploy stuff -> #eng-infra (include error logs)
- Runtime/latency questions -> #eng-runtime
- Product/feature context -> #product
- Team-specific FYIs -> post in your team channel but 'reply in thread' for follow-ups

Maya J.: Another pattern: reactions > reply when its just acknowledgement. Saves a lot of noise. Example: :thumbsup: on a post means "acknowledged".

Nina Park: Good call on reactions. How do i mute bots but still get pager/incident alerts?

Samir: Two steps I use: 1) Channel-level: click channel > View apps > find the bot > turn off non-critical notifications. 2) Personal keywords: set a notification keyword for your name and "pager" so mobile + desktop ping you only when it matters.

DevEx Bot: Hi Nina :wave: — welcome! Useful links: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/slack-guide and https://intranet.redwood/devex/bots-guide.
Commands you can run from any channel:
```
/onboard subscribe-digest  # daily onboarding highlights to DM
/onboard unsubscribe
/bot mute DeployBot         # mute DeployBot in current channel (app-specific)
```
To reduce noise from DeployBot while keeping failure alerts: channel > Integrations > DeployBot > set "only notify on failures".

HR Bot: If you want formal quiet hours on notifications (e.g., PTO or focus time), set "Do Not Disturb" in Slack or run `/dnd 23:00-08:00` from desktop/mobile. Also update your status so teammates know you're offline.

Luis Ramirez: Pro tip: Use channel pins and bookmarks for onboarding resources so new conversations don't bury them. And if something needs to be actioned by multiple people, call it out in the first message: e.g., "@eng-infra please review (action: add deploy role)".

Maya J.: Templates that help us triage faster: 
- For #help: "Name / Team / Resource requested / Error or reason / Urgency (low/med/high)"
- For #eng-infra: paste exact command + logs, add role/host you need access to

Nina Park: This is super helpful, thanks! One last thing — does anyone volunteer to be a quick buddy for setup?

Samir: I can help this afternoon, ping me a DM and i'll walk through SSH and Docker setup.

Nina Park: Amazing — thanks all :heart:
